name: Forge
description: Curated OpenClaw adapter for the Forge collaboration API, UI entrypoint, and localhost auto-start runtime.

origin.label: Forge Origin
origin.help: Protocol and host for Forge without the port. Example: http://127.0.0.1. Localhost targets auto-start Forge.

port.label: Forge Port
port.help: Forge server port. Change this if your local machine uses another port.

dataRoot.label: Forge Data Root
dataRoot.help: Optional absolute folder path for Forge data. Defaults to ~/.forge. When set, Forge stores forge.sqlite directly in this folder; use the same value across adapters that should share one database.

apiToken.label: Forge API Token
apiToken.help: Optional bearer token. Leave blank for one-step localhost or Tailscale operator-session bootstrap.

actorLabel.label: Actor Label
actorLabel.help: Optional acting user label for provenance. Leave blank to inherit the local operator session label, or set one when a child agent should announce itself under a specific user.

injectBootstrapContext.label: Inject Bootstrap Context
injectBootstrapContext.help: Enabled by default. Turn this off when you want OpenClaw sessions to start without a preseeded Forge BOOTSTRAP.md context file to conserve token budget.

timeoutMs.label: Request Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait before the plugin aborts an upstream Forge request.

origin.description: Forge protocol and host without the port. Example: http://127.0.0.1. Localhost targets auto-start the bundled Forge runtime.

port.description: Forge server port. Override this when your local machine uses a different port.

dataRoot.description: Absolute path for the shared Forge data root. Defaults to ~/.forge. Explicit values override that default; use the same value across local adapters that should share one database.

apiToken.description: Optional bearer token for remote or explicit scoped access. Localhost and Tailscale Forge instances can bootstrap an operator session automatically.

actorLabel.description: Optional acting user label recorded in Forge provenance headers. Leave blank to inherit the local operator session label automatically.

injectBootstrapContext.description: Whether OpenClaw should inject a preseeded Forge BOOTSTRAP.md file into new agent sessions. Disable this to conserve context or model-token budget.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for proxy calls from the OpenClaw plugin to Forge.
